question: Hey AI—could use a hand here. Of these six legal moves (g2, b6, a7, b7, b8, c8), which one puts me in the best shape for the rest of the endgame? I care about final disc count, not just immediate flips.
Okay, the board’s done and I lost 31-33. Walk me through where I went wrong—after b7, was c8 a mistake? g2 felt strong at the time but White punished me with h1.
So what should I have played instead of g2 at that point? My legal moves were b6, a7, c8. Would a7 have been the right call?
One more thing—after I played b7, White went a8. That seemed slow, but it set up a3 later which wrecked my a-file. What was the tactical idea behind a8?
Last one—when I played c8 earlier, it only flipped d8. If a7 was the winning move instead of g2, would c8 have ever been useful later, or was it just a wasted tempo no matter what?
